mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 72 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 75.

The City of Verona has launched a rain barrel rebate program to help manage stormwater. Additionally, the city has updated sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure our infrastructure remains self-supporting and reliable for all residents.

There is plenty to do in town with the Epic User Group Meeting today, plus trivia nights at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

On Friday, August 15, Verona police officers stopped a driver who was operating while intoxicated for the second time, which also resulted in citations for failing to use an ignition interlock device and having open intoxicants.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the delicious Caramel Chocolate Pecan flavor before they close their doors for the night at 10 PM.
